$note.{kind}: Base character XP for killing an enemy out of the roster {pool} draws from. Multiply by the enemy-level factor and that enemy's level.
Multiplier on the whole fight's character XP (win plus kills) when {pool} is fought. Owner 2026-11-18: an elite pays six times, a boss triple (pace tuned with tools/level-pace-sim.mjs).

$note.combatWin: Base XP multiplied by the total combat power of defeated enemies and the combat-power multiplier after a win.
$note.combatPowerMultiplier: Multiplier on defeated-enemy combat power for a win. Combat power adds level, health, poise, attack, and a small equipment bonus.
$note.killLevelMultiplier: Multiply each kill's base XP and enemy level by this factor. At 0.2, two level-5 kills give 20 XP before combat-power XP.
$note.quest: Character XP for a completed quest.
